Insane. 🇪🇸⭐
𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐂𝐔𝐋𝐄𝐑𝐒 💙❤

🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Despite previous setbacks, Barcelona and Limak have reached an agreement to complete the Camp Nou. Work on the stadium roof will begin at the end of this season and continue until the second half of the 2027/28 season. [@JoanPoquiEraso] #fcblive 🔵🔴
🔙 𝐓𝐇𝐑𝐎𝐖𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊: On this day in 2003, 16-year-old Lionel Messi made his Barça first-team debut, coming on in the 75th minute of a friendly against FC Porto. The beginning of greatness. #fcblive 🐐
Fermín’s passion is UNMATCHED 🔥🇪🇸
🚨🎖️| Koundé is still NOT training with the group. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive ❌
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Dani Olmo returned to training today and is expected to be available for the match against Villarreal. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive 🔵🔴
🚨🎙️| Carlo Ancelotti, on Raphinha: “He was the one who asked to STAY with the group. He showed a lot of affection for the national team, which is an important sign.” 🇧🇷
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Pau Cubarsí has no injury, but is experiencing thigh overload. He is doubtful for Villarreal, with his availability depending on his recovery. [@martinezferran] #fcblive 🔵🔴
🚨| 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Pau Cubarsí is suffering from tightness in his hip flexor (iliopsoas). His recovery will determine whether he is available for the match against Villarreal. #fcblive
Today's 𝐖𝐈𝐍𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 🔥
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Ibrahim Diarra will be sidelined for three to four weeks after suffering a setback with his hamstring injury. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive 🔵🔴

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Tests today have revealed that Hafiz Gariba has NOT suffered any serious injury, he just has a muscle overload. He will be closely monitored this week, with his availability for the next match to be decided. [@scapde_45] #fcblive
Olmo is BACK in training 👀
📲 | Gordon on IG: England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿❤️
No rest days 🔥
🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona will listen to offers for both Jules Koundé and Alejandro Balde. One of them or even both could LEAVE. [@MatteMoretto] #fcblive 😯
🚨🗣️ @MatteMoretto: “Pedro Porro is NOT an option for Barcelona in January.” #fcblive ❌
Training today. 📸🏃
Hard work continues 🔥
𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐬 💙❤

🚨 𝐈𝐍𝐓’𝐋 𝐖𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇: Barça players in action for their national teams today —

🇪🇬: Hamza Abdelkarim vs. Malawi

🇪🇸: Marc Bernal vs. Albania U21

🇵🇹: João Cancelo vs. Wales

🚨🎙️| Lucas Vázquez: "I think Lamine is something we've NEVER seen before. A player so important at that age, at least I've never seen it. We've had other players in the running for the Ballon d'Or, but he already has the status of a HUGE star." #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Alongside monitoring 20-year-old Cagliari centre-back Juan Rodríguez, Barça scouts also traveled to La Bombonera for the Argentina–Uruguay match to observe him alongside Lisandro Martínez, though no deal is currently in the works. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive
🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: PSG want BALDE. [@CorSport - pending further confirmation] #fcblive 🔵

Raphinha and Carlo Ancelotti, both suspended, watching the Singapore vs. Brazil game from the stands.

Brazil are 4-0 ahead in the 32nd minute. 🇧🇷⚽
🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jorge Mendes is set to arrive in Barcelona today to hold a face-to-face meeting with Alejandro Balde and assess his future. [@monfortcarlos] #fcblive

🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Jules Koundé is CLOSE to returning. He has been experiencing positive sensations and is aiming the Villarreal game. Kounde is expected to rejoin group training on Thursday. [@fansjavimiguel & @NilSola10] #fcblive 🇫🇷
🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona have reached a verbal agreement to renew Brian Fariñas’ contract until 2031. Hansi Flick is convinced of the player. [@Nilsola10] #fcblive 🔵🔴

🚨 Who's the first to arrive at training?

Gordon: "Christensen, everytime I come he's in the shower (laughs)." #fcblive 😂
